text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah, baby!! What a massive haul!!

Gold Ship showed us another wonderful 
performance!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, that's how an Umamusume of the 
sea lives! I'll wave that big catch flag 
with everything I've got, too!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —As expected, Golshi-san.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, if it isn't Flash.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"You had some great fishing spirit in you 
too! The fishing boat was practically 
roaring...!!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I am honored by your praise. By the way, 
do you remember our promise for today?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That's the one where if you fish up 
the legendary giant squid, you can trade 
it for shark fin, right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
There seems to be a slight 
misunderstanding... However, as promised, 
I shall give this to you.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Th-This is...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This is a hint to reach Eden, entrusted to 
me by a certain someone.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So... if we just follow this, we can reach 
Eden!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, but that is beyond my 
purview. I am merely a messenger, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"However, if we follow the terms, then we 
shall meet again. Farewell."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heh... Now that sounds interesting!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Curious about it too? Fine by me, I'll 
read it out loud for ya!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Truth be told, Eden lies deep beneath the 
sea..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Searching without any clues would be an 
impossible task. Therefore, I have 
prepared four keywords as hints."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Face even stronger foes and collect their 
keywords—by The Secret Tome."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Fight formidable rivals to acquire the 
keywords, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Judging from what Flash said earlier, I 
might end up having to fight her again 
too."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Hell yeah! I'm gettin' fired up nowww!"

That lighthearted "by Secret Scroll" tone 
still bothers me as much as ever.

Besides, who could this "person" who 
entrusted Eishin Flash with the message 
be...?

Though it leaves me a little curious, Gold 
Ship is motivated for her upcoming races, 
so let's call it a win!
